title: Prudent Strategy
body_html:
Prudent Strategy

A mixed strategy $\sigma_i\in\Delta(S_i)$ is prudent for player $i$ if, for every pure opponent profile $s_{-i}\in S_{-i}$, $$ g_i(\sigma_i,s_{-i})\ge \max_{\tau_i\in\Delta(S_i)} \min_{t_{-i}\in S_{-i}} g_i(\tau_i,t_{-i}). $$ Thus a prudent strategy guarantees player $i$ at least the player's maxmin security payoff.
